title: CrisisGuardUnifiedIntelligenceSchema
description: Standardized schema contract for the Phase 9 multi-stream intelligence layer in CrisisGuard. Enforces strict provenance preservation across synthetic media, crisis information, propagation graph, and spatial infrastructure streams without artificial or fabricated joins.

stream_id.description: Origin stream identifier preserving parallel multi-stream architecture.

record_id.description: Unique canonical record identifier within the stream's domain.

source_dataset.description: Original raw/curated dataset of origin (e.g. CIFAKE, Google_DFD, humaid_all_combined, crisislex_t6_and_t26, crisismmd_multimodal, semi_synthetic_cascades, openstreetmap_geofabrik).

event_id.description: Event-level identifier or incident tag. NULL if not applicable to the stream.

node_id.description: Network vertex identifier for social graph or road infrastructure. NULL if not applicable.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of prediction, transmission, or capture. NULL if unhydrated.

media_risk.description: Bounded synthetic media risk score in [0.0, 1.0]. NULL if media intelligence is unavailable.

media_risk_available.description: True if genuine media risk score is present; False otherwise.

crisis_model_score.description: Model confidence or score for humanitarian crisis category. NULL if unavailable.

crisis_confidence.description: Bounded confidence metric for crisis classification. NULL if unavailable.

crisis_prediction.description: Predicted or ground-truth humanitarian crisis category. NULL if unavailable.

crisis_intelligence_available.description: True if genuine crisis information features are present; False otherwise.

pagerank.description: GraphX structural centrality score. Strictly represents structural bottleneck authority; does not imply causal origin. NULL if unavailable.

degree.description: Total node degree in the propagation graph. NULL if unavailable.

component_id.description: Connected component identifier from GraphX. NULL if unavailable.

propagation_activity.description: Diffusion regime or activity classification. NULL if unavailable.

propagation_intelligence_available.description: True if genuine propagation graph features are present; False otherwise.

spatial_intelligence_available.description: True if genuine physical spatial/road infrastructure coordinates are present; False otherwise.

stream_window.description: Streaming time window identifier. NULL if unavailable.

calibration_status.description: Statistical probability calibration validity. Uncalibrated models are never interpreted as true posterior probabilities.

provenance.description: Full end-to-end data lineage and governance tag.

governance_type.description: Classification of data veracity according to Course Big Data Governance standards.
